sounds.name: Swing Time
sounds.ref: The manual’s Swing Time patch sheet: the PITCH row setting each step’s length
sounds.blurb: A clave-like pattern whose steps are long and short: PITCH into TEMPO.
sounds.how: The PITCH output into TEMPO adds each step’s voltage to the clock, a volt an octave: a step turned up is short, one turned down long. Here the app locks the clock to the bar’s beat, so each step snaps to the nearest whole division of it: the steps alternate between eighths and sixteenths, a swing in whole numbers. SEQ PITCH MOD is OFF, so the pitch stays put. The cables are the sheet’s; the manual draws its knobs without numbers, so their settings here are this lesson’s.
